verdict.rationale: Viam's docs name official SDKs in all four requested languages: control logic in Python or Go, lower-level control in C++, and client apps in TypeScript, plus Flutter. The GitHub repo confirms multiple SDKs, and the API reference shows them spanning machine control, fleet management ("the same way you can do in the web UI"), and ML training, with built-in transport, session, and reconnect handling. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the SDKs are typed, proof that each language covers the full platform surface (C++ is framed only as "lower-level control" and TypeScript as client apps), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
